text: {"label":"Delay and probability discounting","definition":"Research on how delay, uncertainty, and social distance reduce the subjective value of outcomes, including discounting assessment methods, magnitude and framing effects, losses versus gains, and quantitative discounting models.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Focuses on devaluation of delayed or uncertain outcomes, rather than conditioned reinforcement and reinforcement-rate effects on choice, behavioral economics broadly, or general models of preference and changeover."}
